idea-plugin.name: Tree View
idea-plugin.description:
Simplify and beautify your projects with Farsroidx - Tree View!

Tired of JetBrains' default project view messing up your clean structures? This plugin completely reimagines how you navigate through your code, keeping everything organized and ultra-fast.

🛠️ Supported Projects (Current Version):
    Maven Project:
    • 📦 Maven Single-Module Projects (Perfect, clean layout for standalone applications)
    • 🗂️ Maven Multi-Module Projects (Beautifully nested hierarchy for large, complex architectures)
    • 🔄 Hybrid Maven Projects (Perfectly supports both Single and Multi-Module structures side-by-side in the same project view!)
* Note: Gradle and other build systems are coming soon in future updates!

⚡ Key Features:
  • 🌳 Clean Package Compacting: Displays your Java/Kotlin packages in a beautiful, compacted hierarchy, keeping the layout clean and intuitive.
  • 🎨 Real-time VCS Integration: Visualizes Git statuses with accurate file-color syncing instantly.
  • 🌀 Flicker-Free UI: Built with a smart loading manager (and a sleek spinner!) to eliminate annoying UI blinks and jumps during project syncs.
  • 🔄 Smart Tree-State Memory: Automatically remembers your expanded/collapsed folders even after reopening the project.
  • 🎯 Smart Sorting: Keeps your primary modules sorted by your build configuration, while keeping internal files beautifully alphabetized (Folders first, then files!).

💡 Missing Source Folders? (Quick Fix): If IntelliJ indexing gets stuck and some of your source or resource roots (like src/main/java) don't show up correctly, don't panic! You can easily force-sync them in 2 clicks:
  1. Right-click anywhere on the Project Tree View.
  2. Look right below the New ➕ menu and click on "Sync Project Source Roots". 🔄✨

Say goodbye to chaotic file lists and welcome a supercharged, clean development workflow!

And this is just the beginning. Stay tuned for more exciting updates and features in the future!! 🔥😎

action.description: Automatically detects and configures project source and resource roots.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.1.1 - Tree View Loading Fix & Refresh Stability 🛠️

This patch release resolves a critical UI state issue that could cause the custom project tree to remain stuck on the loading screen after switching between Project View panes.

  • ✅ Fixed Loading State Restoration: Resolved an issue where returning to the Farsroidx Tree View could incorrectly keep the view on the loading screen instead of showing the restored tree.
  • 🔄 Improved Tree Refresh Flow: Refined the refresh lifecycle to better handle pane switching, project view restoration, and Maven readiness checks.
  • 🧯 Prevented Refresh Storms: Removed unnecessary recursive file status refresh triggers that could cause repeated tree invalidations and UI pressure.
  • ⚡ Smoother View Switching: Improved stability when switching between different Project View modes, reducing unnecessary rebuilds and repaint operations.

v1.1.0 - Refined Visuals & Stability 🚀

This update focuses on visual consistency and platform stability to ensure the best development experience.

  • 🎨 Professional Test Highlighting: Recalibrated test folder background colors to align perfectly with JetBrains' design language (Muted Olive).
  • ⚙️ Updated IDE Compatibility: Bumped minimum IDEA version to 2023.3+ to leverage newer platform APIs and improved performance.
  • 🛠️ Internal Optimization: Refined the project tree rendering engine for even smoother navigation and better resource handling.

v1.0.0 - Initial Release 🎉

Say hello to the ultimate Project Tree View! This release introduces a highly optimized, fully customized tree view for JetBrains IDEs to supercharge your project navigation.

  • 🌳 Compact Package View: Displays Kotlin/Java package structures in a compact, organized hierarchy just like standard package views.
  • 🔤 Smart Alphabetical Sorting: Internal directories and package nodes are now sorted alphabetically, placing folders perfectly at the top and files right below them.
  • 📜 Single & Multi-Module Support: Fully supports both Maven Single-Module and Multi-Module structures, keeping modules sorted exactly as defined in your root configurations.
  • 🎨 Seamless VCS Colors: Active Git status colors are fully synced in real-time, providing an immediate visual cue for your modified files.
  • 💾 Tree State Restoration: Never lose your place! The plugin remembers your exact expanded folders and tree state across IDE restarts.
  • ⚡ Zero Flicker Loading: Features a smooth CardLayout loading screen with an animated spinner, preventing UI jumps during initial sync.
